
LIST-VIRTUAL-HOOKS
List all virtual hooks configured for a work unit

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command to view all virtual hooks attached to a specific work unit. Shows hooks grouped by event with their configuration (blocking, git context, command). Useful for reviewing quality checks before workflow transitions or debugging hook execution.

PREREQUISITES
  • Work unit must exist

USAGE
  fspec list-virtual-hooks <workUnitId>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID to list hooks for (e.g., AUTH-001)

OPTIONS
  No options available

COMMON PATTERNS
  • Review Quality Gates Before Implementing
    Example: fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
# Review hooks, then:
fspec update-work-unit-status AUTH-001 implementing
    Check what quality checks will run before starting implementation.

  • Debug Hook Execution
    Example: fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
# If hook fails, review command and fix
    When a hook fails, list hooks to see the exact command being executed.

  • Compare Hooks Across Work Units
    Example: fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-002
    Compare quality checks between related work units to ensure consistency.


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  Add virtual hooks → fspec list-virtual-hooks → Review configuration → Update hooks if needed → Execute workflow transition

EXAMPLES
  1. List all virtual hooks for AUTH-001
  $ fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
  Virtual Hooks for AUTH-001:

  post-implementing:
    • eslint [blocking]
      <quality-check-commands>
    • prettier [non-blocking]
      prettier --check .

  pre-validating:
    • typecheck [blocking]
      <quality-check-commands>

  2. List hooks for a work unit with no virtual hooks
  $ fspec list-virtual-hooks BUG-042
  No virtual hooks configured for BUG-042

  3. List hooks including git context hooks
  $ fspec list-virtual-hooks FEAT-123
  Virtual Hooks for FEAT-123:

  post-implementing:
    • eslint [blocking] [git-context]
      spec/hooks/.virtual/FEAT-123-eslint.sh

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Work unit 'AUTH-001' does not exist
    Fix: Check work unit ID spelling or create work unit first: fspec create-story AUTH "Title" (or create-bug/create-task)

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-virtual-hook
  fspec remove-virtual-hook
  fspec clear-virtual-hooks
  fspec show-work-unit

NOTES
  • Hooks are displayed grouped by event for clarity
  • [blocking] badge indicates hook failure prevents workflow transition
  • [git-context] badge indicates hook uses git staged/unstaged files
  • Hooks execute in the order they were added (top to bottom)
  • Virtual hooks also appear in "fspec show-work-unit" output
  • Empty output means no virtual hooks configured for the work unit
